mapper.select:
select u.user_id , u.user_name , u.email , u.phone , u.user_type , u.status , u.joined_at , u.withdrawn_at , p.product_id , pd.product_name from user u left outer join pay p on u.user_id = p.user_id left outer join product pd on p.product_id = pd.product_id where u.user_type = 'p'
and p.product_id is null
and p.product_id = #{type}
and 1=1
and u.status = #{status}
and u.user_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')
order by
u.joined_at asc
u.joined_at desc
u.user_name asc
u.user_id asc

select u.user_id , u.user_name , u.email , u.phone , u.user_type , u.status , u.joined_at , u.withdrawn_at , p.birth_date , p.gender , p.country , p.pass_count , p.report_received_count , p.profile_url from user u join user_person p on u.user_id = p.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update user set status = 'suspended' where user_id = #{userId}
update user set status = 'active' where user_id = #{userId}

SELECT b.ad_id, c.company_name, j.title AS job_title, p.pay_date AS pay_date, -- 시작일(결제일) cp.end_date AS expiry_date, -- 종료일 b.is_display FROM banner b JOIN USER_COMPANY c ON b.comp_id = c.user_id JOIN JOB_POSTING j ON b.job_id = j.job_id LEFT JOIN pay p ON b.comp_id = p.user_id AND p.pay_status = 'paid' LEFT JOIN com_product cp ON p.pay_id = cp.pay_id ORDER BY b.ad_id DESC
